sourceContext: Human explicitly says start working now and authorizes ORCHESTOR to proceed without further routine confirmation. This command is the immediate execution handoff for the finalized organization/productization requirements in command 04.
objective: START NOW: consume this command as the single active ORCHESTOR Core task, establish/repair the project-scoped folder and exactly one valid persistent Codex thread, create exactly one active run, perform FIRST_DISPATCH, and continue autonomously through productization until PROJECT_COMPLETE=YES or a genuine human safety gate.
why: All routine local authority is already granted. The user does not want another planning-only stop; this command exists to move the runtime into active execution immediately.
scope: Supersede CC-ORCHESTOR-PRODUCTIZE-20260930-04 and all earlier ORCHESTOR-core commands. Do not dispatch older commands again.
Use visible task/thread display name `ORCHESTOR Core`.
Create/use %LOCALAPPDATA%\Orchestor\projects\orchestor\tasks\core-productization\ and the project-scoped threads/runs/locks/logs/results/cache hierarchy if missing.

Inspect for exactly one valid existing Codex app-server thread owned by this task. Reuse it if provable; otherwise create exactly one new persistent thread using the existing authenticated Codex app-server/session path.
Persist the thread binding atomically before dispatch; no anonymous/random visible thread name.
Create exactly one new active durable run for this command; preserve old failed/superseded runs as historical evidence.
Start/restart the daemon only through the certified zero-visible-window launcher.
Perform FIRST_DISPATCH immediately after identity/thread/run validation. FIRST_DISPATCH is explicitly authorized.
Persist dispatch acknowledgement and transition the run into active autonomous execution.

Continue the full requirements from command 04: installable/portable ORCHESTOR agent, ON/OFF/PAUSED/NEEDS_YOU UX, global state outside repos, arbitrary project onboarding, multi-project and multi-task lanes, isolated worktrees/threads/runs/locks, conflict serialization, hard cross-project write sandboxing, autonomous implement-test-review-repair loop, delayed review handling, restart recovery, notifications, packaging, docs and final multi-project/multi-task E2E certification.
Do not stop for routine technical issues that are safely repairable within ORCHESTOR-core authority. Repair and continue.
Stop only for a genuine approval/safety gate or bounded no-progress condition.
Do not modify Costa Clean application/product source.
outOfScope: Secrets/credentials, DNS, billing/payments, real external communications, destructive remote actions.
Privileged Windows service installation or system-wide policy changes.
Direct OpenAI API or OPENAI_API_KEY usage.
acceptanceCriteria: ORCHESTOR Core task folder exists in the project-scoped global hierarchy.
Exactly one active persistent Codex thread is bound to this task with display name `ORCHESTOR Core` or ORCHESTOR-managed equivalent if native title support is unavailable.
Exactly one active durable run exists for this command.
No visible terminal windows appear during normal background operation.
All command 04 productization acceptance criteria remain in force.
Final state reaches PROJECT_COMPLETE=YES or a genuine human safety gate.
requiredApprovals: Any Supabase or other remote database mutation.
Any secret/credential creation, rotation or disclosure.
Any DNS, billing, payment or real external communication.
Any material expansion beyond ORCHESTOR productization and non-production certification.
stopConditions: No safe unique thread ownership can be established without ambiguity.
Zero-visible-window behavior regresses and cannot be repaired safely.
A forbidden or approval-required real-world side effect becomes necessary.
Bounded no-progress guards are exhausted with unresolved correctness/security findings.
verificationRequirements: Report ORCHESTOR_HOME, PROJECT_FOLDER, TASK_FOLDER and TASK_DISPLAY_NAME.
Continue all verification requirements from command 04 through final PROJECT_COMPLETE certification.
